name: Hindustan Zinc Ltd
description: AboutIncorporated in 1966, Hindustan Zinc in Zinc-Lead and Silver business is world’s 2nd largest integrated Zinc producer and Hindustan Zinc is the 3rd largest silver producer globally with an annual capacity of 800MT . The company has a market share of ~75% of the growing Zinc market in India with its headquarters at Zinc City, Udaipur along with Zinc-Lead mines and smelting complexes spread across the state of Rajasthan.[1]Key PointsBusiness Segments[1]a) Zinc, Lead and Silver (94% in Q1 FY27 vs 97% in Q1 FY26):[2][3]The company is the world’slargestintegrated zinc producer and is amongst thetop 10silver producers globally. It supplies to more than40countries and holds a market share of about74%of the primary zinc market in India. Its portfolio supports key sectors like infrastructure, railways, mobility, power, renewable energy and digital technologies, with applications ranging from construction, automotive and batteries to solar PV, semiconductors, jewellery and emerging solution
